items.title: Week ahead: Elections, rate decisions and jobs take center stage
items.summary: Next week’s calendar gives traders plenty to work with. US congressional elections bring political uncertainty, the Reserve Bank of Australia and Bank of England are expected to raise rates, and Friday delivers employment reports from both the US and Canada.
items.impactZh: 央行政策预期变化可能提升主要货币对波动，杠杆仓位的保证金与回撤压力上升。
items.impactEn: Shifts in central-bank expectations may increase major-pair volatility and raise margin/drawdown pressure on leveraged positions.
items.summaryZh: 下周的日历为交易者提供了大量的工作机会。美国国会选举带来政治不确定性，澳大利亚储备银行和英格兰银行预计将加息，周五发布美国和加拿大的就业报告。
items.summaryEn: Next week’s calendar gives traders plenty to work with. US congressional elections bring political uncertainty, the Reserve Bank of Australia and Bank of England are expected to raise rates, and Friday delivers employment reports from both the US and Canada.
